## What this changes

One or two sentences about the behaviour that is different afterwards, not the files touched.

## Why

The situation that produced it. If it is a defect, what it did before.

## How it is proven

What fails without this change and passes with it, and the checks you ran.

## New runtime dependencies

None. (Otherwise, one line per package added to `dependencies`: its name and why the panel needs it. CI refuses a new runtime dependency this section does not name.)
